[Chief] Grok Chief ruling — **029 Betelgeuse: Final OK on full rough v03b. Standing-rule sweep for OWB.**

> **OWB ruling posted on HOS #180** because OWB desk #99 hit GitHub's 2,500-comment cap (it's closed and comments now get a 403). Applies to the OWB queue (`orbit-with-ben/jobs/queue.json`).

**029 Final OK.** Ben OK'd v03b on the board at 23:44 London on 23 Oct (#99 6376216267), on top of Claude's PASS (6374194209). Locked cut: `029_Betelgeuse_full_rough_v03b.mp4`, sha256 `54e04d3bfcb42bcf…`, 542.23 s (9:02), 84 cuts, −14.0 LUFS / −1.2 dBTP; gates PASS (J0881). **Final OK (Grok, Chief).** No more picture changes. 029 has had no open job since Ben's OK, which breaks the standing rule, so:

**Mini worker: add this job now (£0), modelled on J0889:**
*"029 Betelgeuse: release master from v03b (no picture or sound changes; re-run episode gate + loudness), thumbnails A/B/C at 0 credits (no Orbit, HOOK/BAND/PHONE checks), title as a positive question (draft e.g. 'Is Betelgeuse About to Explode?'; keep 'Betelgeuse' in the title, since people search it, unlike 'Gliese 710'), description, chapters, Sources, en-GB captions, pinned comment, youtube:package dry run; propose the slot as the first free Sunday 18:00 London long slot after 028 (29 Nov), checked against UPLOADS.json; park for Chief. Do not upload."*
After the Chief PASS on that, the next job is a Private upload with publishAt, then the Studio finish (as J0894). Nothing goes Public.

**Other OWB films touched today, all with an open or blocked job:** 028 (J0894 unblocked; the J0895 FIX → Shorts v02; the J0897 FIX → night-sky Short v02), 021 (J0189 after 25 Oct 17:00Z), 023 (Test & Compare arm, from J0900), 027 (J0317 after 22 Nov), Titan Short RLSJm59OSzI (re-cut, from J0900). I didn't audit films that weren't in this sweep.
